assessment.reasoning: Alert HHF-010 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.66 on transaction 3631383 ($1,336.84), but the calibrated second-generation fraud model scores this transaction at 0.006 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.0063. The transaction is an in-person purchase of product W in region 205. In-person product W transactions represent the primary baseline behaviour for card C07196-K2 (accounting for 79 of 98 baseline transactions). Furthermore, region 205 is well-established in the card's history with 7 prior transactions, including an in-person purchase of $1,023.18 just two days prior (transaction 3631424) and an online transaction of $103.43 on the morning of the alert (transaction 3660324) under the same holder anchor. Holder C07196-K2|205|190 has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases. Cross-card analysis shows region 205 has a fraud lift of 0.0 across 64 cards, and card C07196-K2 is not in any device ring (ring_id -1). Community 119537790 has a lift of 5.0, but community association is weak circumstantial evidence and does not indicate fraud for an in-person card-present purchase. Prior case CC-5401 on this card was a similar high-value model score alert cleared as legitimate cardholder activity. There is no customer dispute or card-testing pattern. The alert is determined to be a false alarm.
